title: Propensity Sandbox: standardized micro-benchmarking for enterprise vertical model-fit
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Sales and Solutions teams repeatedly ask whether a given open model variant is 'production-ready' for regulated enterprise verticals (finserv/legal/health). We lack a lightweight, repeatable way to surface availability, latency economics, quantization/compatibility risk, and prompt fragility for narrow-domain workloads.

Proposal: Build a Propensity Sandbox — a self-service harness + micro-benchmark suite that will run short, representative workloads across candidate model variants (hosted/dedicated/private) and produce a compact 'propensity score' for enterprise fit. The sandbox should: 1) run standardized vertical templates (finserv, support-RAG, healthcare triage), 2) collect latency, cost-per-token, quality regressions against reference prompts, and quantization compatibility flags, 3) integrate with Console dashboards and the model catalog to surface signals to PM/Sales/SRE.

Scope: MVP focuses on three vertical templates, 6 canonical prompts each, automated runs daily for prioritized models, and a results dashboard + one-pager PRD for GTM. Excludes full eval infra (we will link to evals team for deeper regression analysis).
acceptance_criteria: Sandbox can be triggered from a simple UI or CLI to run a named vertical template against a model variant
Runs produce a JSON results artifact with latency distribution, token-cost estimate, pass/fail on prompt-based quality checks, and quant-compatibility note
Results are ingested into a Console dashboard (per-model 'propensity' tile) and a CSV export for sales ops
Automated nightly run for top-10 candidate models configured and operational
PRD and short-runbook documented with links to artifacts and owners
success_metrics: Time to answer for RFP questions reduced from 3 days to < 4 hours (measured by sales feedback)
>80% of evaluated enterprise PoCs have a propensity score and basic report available within 24 hours of request
Sandbox runs maintain cost < $X per model per nightly run (cost gating threshold)
tasks: Draft PRD + acceptance criteria (PM) — link to draft
Define 3 vertical workload templates and canonical prompts (PM + Solutions)
Implement harness: runner that calls Redwood API variants, records latency, token counts, and structured result outputs (Eng)
Add lightweight prompt-based quality checks (exact-match and fuzzy similarity thresholds) and flagging rules
Quantization/compatibility probe: quick infer path smoke tests and kernel-failure detection
Ingest artifacts into Console dashboard and create a per-model 'propensity' tile
Create a CLI wrapper and basic UX for Sales to request ad-hoc runs
Cost gating: nightly budget monitor + alerting (SRE)
Write runbook and one-pager for GTM and sales enablement
